resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Indonesian source scope, prior review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Indonesian pass identified 25 actionable circuit, thermal, imperative-grammar, SI, and wire-gauge defects; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Indonesian human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The Kirchhoff description was vague about the conserved quantities.
evidence: The previous text referred generally to conservation at nodes and closed loops.
findings.resolution: Named charge conservation at nodes and energy conservation in closed loops.

findings.summary: The current-law example used a repetitive and less direct branch phrase.
evidence: The previous sentence repeated membawa ... keluar and used a less clear current-flow order.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with current leaving through one branch and a total of 5 A through the remaining branches.

findings.summary: The KVL paragraph used less natural wording for voltage rises, drops, and loop direction.
evidence: The previous paragraph used tegangan naik dan turun and an indirect physical-solution phrase.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with kenaikan, penurunan, loop, polarities, and series-component wording.

findings.summary: The series-cell capacity sentence was ambiguous about the equivalent cell.
evidence: The previous sentence said capacity is the same as one cell without clarifying equivalence.
findings.resolution: Clarified that series capacity matches one equivalent cell.

findings.summary: The resistor relationship did not explicitly say voltage is across the resistor.
evidence: The previous bullet said to connect resistor voltage and current without specifying their relationship.
findings.resolution: Changed it to voltage on the resistor and the current through it using V = I × R.

findings.summary: The high-current circuit phrase was a literal translation.
evidence: The previous paragraph ended with rangkaian arus tinggi.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the natural Indonesian rangkaian berarus tinggi.

findings.summary: The constant-voltage TCR paragraph used digerakkan for a resistive load.
evidence: The previous text described a resistance as driven at constant voltage.
findings.resolution: Changed it to diberi tegangan konstan.

findings.summary: The angle-mode paragraph used siklus for a complete angular turn.
evidence: The previous sentence called a complete turn satu siklus penuh.
findings.resolution: Changed it to satu putaran penuh.

findings.summary: The heating-time formula localized the protected unit s as the word detik.
evidence: The formula ended with 418 detik while the technical formulas use SI symbols.
findings.resolution: Restored the protected result as 418 s.

findings.summary: The phase-change paragraph used panas laten instead of the established kalor terminology.
evidence: The surrounding heat-capacity content uses kapasitas kalor and the phase-change quantity is latent heat.
findings.resolution: Changed it to kalor laten spesifik.

findings.summary: The heat-flux display name omitted the density/per-area meaning.
evidence: The previous display name was Fluks kalor despite W/m² content.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Kepadatan fluks kalor.

findings.summary: The heat-flux description did not explicitly define transfer per unit area.
evidence: The previous description said heat crosses a surface without stating per-area rate.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as heat-transfer rate per unit area.

findings.summary: The heat-flux example title omitted the density term.
evidence: The previous title was Rata-rata fluks pemanas.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Rata-rata kepadatan fluks kalor pemanas.

findings.summary: The heat-flux conclusion named fluks kalor while reporting density units.
evidence: W/m² and W/cm² identify heat-flux density.
findings.resolution: Changed it to kepadatan fluks kalor and retained both units.

findings.summary: The conduction bullet used aliran for heat transfer between temperatures.
evidence: The previous wording did not say that heat itself transfers from high to low temperature.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as kalor berpindah from higher to lower temperature.

findings.summary: The convection paragraph called h a surface coefficient.
evidence: The previous paragraph used koefisien permukaan h.
findings.resolution: Changed it to koefisien konveksi h.

findings.summary: The heat-flux practical check was an infinitive fragment rather than an imperative.
evidence: The previous bullet began Membedakan.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the direct imperative Bedakan and used density terminology.

findings.summary: The SI heading said general SI units rather than SI base units.
evidence: The heading did not distinguish the base-unit table from derived-unit bullets.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Satuan dasar SI.

findings.summary: The SI table header used inconsistent capitalization.
evidence: The second header was satuan SI while the other headers were capitalized.
findings.resolution: Standardized the headers as Kuantitas, Satuan SI, and Simbol.

findings.summary: The wire-gauge comparison table mixed decimal notation and omitted spaces before mm.
evidence: The first row used 2.588mm and later rows mixed 0,8128mm with spaced values.
findings.resolution: Standardized all comparison values to Indonesian comma decimals with a space before mm.

findings.summary: The gauge-number rule used an awkward literal phrase for sizes above gauge zero.
evidence: The previous sentence said angka gauge biasa and used an incomplete use 00 construction.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with a direct higher-number rule and ditulis sebagai 00, 000, atau 0000.

findings.summary: The AWG formulas used a localized variable name for inch diameter.
evidence: The first formula used d_inci rather than the protected d_inch notation.
findings.resolution: Restored d_inch and d_mm with the Indonesian decimal-comma constants.

findings.summary: The system-naming instruction used a literal Indonesian verb.
evidence: The previous bullet said Beri nama sistemnya.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Sebutkan sistemnya.

findings.summary: The nominal-diameter instruction used a literal condition about a confused system.
evidence: The previous bullet said jika sistem mungkin bingung.
findings.resolution: Changed it to jika sistem dapat tertukar.

findings.summary: The stranded-conductor instruction used pilin and untaian less naturally.
evidence: The previous bullet used konduktor pilin and did not use the standard serabut wording.
findings.resolution: Changed it to konduktor serabut and retained the strand-construction requirement.
